The death certificate (src_004) is a third independent original source. The two censuses may share a single household informant (Thomas Flynn or his wife) for birth-origin facts, but for identity purposes they independently document the same person in the same county household ten years apart. The log_005 search returned 2 results, suggesting a second candidate may have been encountered; however, the note records a single positive outcome with one specific certificate naming Thomas Flynn as father, with no note of a viable competing record.

The certificate names Thomas Flynn as father — exactly matching hypothesis h_001, which is independently supported by 1850 census co-enumeration (a_004) and 1860 census co-enumeration (a_010). A second, unrelated Patrick Flynn dying in the same county in the same year with the same birth year and the same father's name would require an extraordinary coincidence that the evidence does not support. The log_005 search note records the certificate as the single positive outcome; the second result examined was apparently not a viable match, since no competing candidate was noted. The birthplace discrepancy (Pennsylvania on the certificate vs. Ireland in the censuses) is already resolved in c_001 as informant error by the son-in-law — it does not point to a different person.
entry.resolution_rationale: The death certificate belongs to I1. The certificate's identifiers — Patrick Flynn, death 1908, Schuylkill County, birth 1845, father Thomas Flynn — collectively match our research subject and no other documented Patrick Flynn in the county. The log_005 search returned 2 results but recorded a single positive outcome; the second result was examined and apparently set aside (no competing candidate was noted). The decisive identifier is the father's name: two independent census records (1850 and 1860) place our Patrick Flynn in Thomas Flynn's Schuylkill County household, and the death certificate names that same father. A second Patrick Flynn in the same county dying in the same year with the same birth year and the same father's name is unsupported by any evidence in this project.
